question: A matrix $B=[b_{ij}]_{2\times 3}$ is defined by $b_{ij}=i^2+j$. Write $B$ explicitly and calculate $b_{23}-b_{12}$.
explanation:
Calculation of entries
For $i=1$, the entries are $2,3,4$. For $i=2$, the entries are $5,6,7$.
Required matrix
$$B=\begin{bmatrix}2 & 3 & 4 \\ 5 & 6 & 7\end{bmatrix}$$
Specified entries
$b_{23}=7$ and $b_{12}=3$. Hence, $$b_{23}-b_{12}=7-3=4$$
